events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body: The driver cancelled this RydeX trip, so the fee's validity is tested through NS-0's driver-cancellation branch (passenger no-show alleged) rather than the rider-cancellation branch [F4][NS-0]. NS-1 requires all three of (i) an "I'm Here" tap, (ii) GPS placing the driver at the pickup when tapping, and (iii) more than 3 minutes of waiting inside the pickup radius after that tap, before the $6.61 can stand [F6][F1][F5][NS-1]. The trace settles (i) and (ii) as satisfied: the driver tapped at 13:02:45 at 41 m, and his closest approach was 38 m [F6][F1][NS-1]. Requirement (iii) fails: after the 13:02:45 tap the driver remained within 200 m for only 2 min 55 s (175 s) before cancelling at 13:05:40, which is short of the >3-minute threshold [F6][F4][NS-1]. His earlier presence in the radius does not cure this, because the policy counts continuous waiting inside the radius from the tap, not from first arrival [F2][F6][NS-1]; the stationary spell of 3 min 15 s began at 13:02:25, twenty seconds before the tap, and ended at cancellation [F3][F6]. Because NS-1 (iii) is unmet, NS-2 directs that the $6.61 cancellation fee be refunded in full [F8][NS-2]. The rider's own timeline supports the complaint that she was charged although she was not given the full statutory waiting window after the driver's tap [F5][F6][NS-2]. No account flag is warranted: the trace finds no fake tap (the driver was genuinely within the radius when he tapped 41 m away), so the NS-2 flagging limb for tapping while off-site does not apply [F6][F1][NS-2]. The refund is $6.61, equal to the cancellation fee actually charged, with no surge component to consider [F8][F9][NS-2]. The traffic and weather records show no incident or condition that would alter the analysis, and in any event NS-1's timing test is dispositive [F13][F14][F15][NS-1].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked into your RydeX cancellation fee and you're getting it back.

What decided it: your driver cancelled at the pickup point, and the rules only let the fee stand if the driver waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup after tapping "I'm Here." He tapped and then cancelled after about 2 minutes 55 seconds, which is short of that. So the fee didn't apply.

You'll receive $6.61 as a Ryde voucher. Nothing else is needed from you.

We're noting the cancellation on the driver's record. No further action is required on your account.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation of your RydeX trip and the $6.61 cancellation fee has been refunded to the rider.

What decided it: the fee can only be kept when you waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup after tapping "I'm Here." The record shows you tapped while at the pickup point, then cancelled about 2 minutes 55 seconds later — short of that waiting window.

The $6.61 goes to the rider as a Ryde voucher. We're recording this cancellation against your cancellation record; no account flag is being applied. Keep in mind that repeated short waits before cancelling can affect your standing.
